blocks.text: Cell signalling cells ki woh salahiyat (ability) hai jis se woh apne mahol (environment) ke stimuli (asar dalne wali cheezon) ka jawab dete hain aur cell ke andar response (radd-e-amal) paida hota hai. Is mein cells ke darmiyan molecules ke ek silsile (series of molecular events) ke zariye signals bheje jate hain, jo aksar cell mein response tak le jate hain.
